name: Every ground mount runs at 100% in a battleground, whatever the rider's Riding skill (#12279)
contract: Report #12279: in a battleground a mount's speed follows the rider's Riding skill, so riders with less training
are slower. On CoA every mounted player in a battleground moves at 100% regardless of training, and outside
battlegrounds the speed keeps following Riding skill (contributor's live CoA experience, 2026-11-14).
AscensionMountSpeed gives a learned mount 40% with Novice, 60% with Apprentice and 100% from Journeyman Riding,
and a collection mount such as Wriggling Parasite 498796 casts its 60% variant 498795 below Journeyman.
Speed is set when the mount is summoned, and a rider keeps the mount through the battleground's teleports, so
joining and leaving recalculate it. Expected with Apprentice Riding (75): the Brown Horse 458 runs at 60% (run
speed rate 1.6) near Northshire, at 100% (rate 2.0) once ridden into Warsong Gulch and when summoned there; the
Wriggling Parasite's 60% variant runs at 100% in Warsong Gulch and at 60% again after riding out.
